mechanics.claim: Naafiri periodically summons a Packmate that fights alongside her, up to the cap; this happens independently of the fight and is not player-triggered damage.
mechanics.quote: Periodically, '''Naafiri''' summons a ''Packmate'' that fights alongside her.

mechanics.claim: Only the initial hit of Darkin Daggers (Q) counts for reducing We Are More's cooldown; the Q bleed does not trigger it.
mechanics.quote: Only the initial hit of ''{{ai|Darkin Daggers|Naafiri}}'' counts for reducing ''We Are More's'' cooldown; the damage over time will not trigger the cooldown reduction.

mechanics.claim: Both hits of Eviscerate (E) trigger the We Are More cooldown reduction.
mechanics.quote: Both hits of ''{{ai|Eviscerate|Naafiri}}'' will trigger the cooldown reduction.

mechanics.claim: Packmates themselves do not count as abilities for triggering the cooldown reduction.
mechanics.quote: ''Packmates'' do not count as abilities for triggering the cooldown reduction.
